intent.raw: Create the draft publication research pipeline route for MOGT using Research Tower for learning and Research Evidence Harness for experiment mechanics.
intent.objective: Chain source understanding, evidence harness dry-run validation, bounded SWU execution, claim adjudication, paper rewrite, and export packaging without overclaiming evidence.
intent.operator_sentence: Use the proposed sigil and spell to decide and execute the next MOGT steps from the already planned work-pack.

route_menu.context_hint: MOGT is already structurally scaffolded and blocked on evidence mechanics, not source-learning alone.

items.label: Spell plus evidence sigil
items.description: Keep Research Tower focused on learning, create Research Evidence Harness for data mechanics, and compose both in a publication pipeline spell.

items.label: Expand Research Tower
items.description: Add experiment mechanics directly to Research Tower, risking a broad mixed-purpose sigil.

items.label: MOGT local only
items.description: Implement MOGT harness mechanics without a reusable Arcanum owner.

technique_overlays.trigger: Research Tower, evidence mechanics, and paper rewrite have different authority boundaries.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Each step names the owning capability and does not mutate another capability's internal contract.

technique_overlays.trigger: MOGT has no live experiment evidence and must not upgrade claims from fixture data.

techniques.purpose: Require synthetic fixture validation before live run claims.
techniques.validation_note: Expressed in evidence-harness and goal-profile gates.

technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The route blocks live experiment execution until schema and fixture validation pass.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Initial draft route and next SWU are locally decidable.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Subagents are not needed for the initial schema/validator SWU; later prior-art or review-rubric phases may add delegated lanes.

steps.name: Select spell plus new evidence sigil route
Keep Research Tower as learning owner and hand off evidence mechanics
Use Research Evidence Harness for MOGT schema and fixture validation
Generate native Codex goal for SWU-MOGT-HARNESS-001
Execute the next MOGT SWU only after goal approval
stop_conditions: Stop with BLOCK if schema and validator cannot be completed from local evidence.

gates.condition: The route must not promote the draft sigil, draft spell, MARS assets, or MOGT findings into canonical Arcanum authority.
Synthetic passing and failing fixtures must validate before any live run or evidence-status upgrade.
The native Codex goal must keep writes inside the SWU-MOGT-HARNESS-001 declared scope.

promotion_guardrails: Draft sigil and spell are not promoted by this route.
Dry-run fixtures do not support MOGT claims.
MARS assets are reference evidence until separately absorbed.
